title: Maximizing the signless Laplacian spectral radius of simplicial 2-complexes with a prescribed second Betti number
summary: We study how a prescribed second Betti number constrains the largest eigenvalue of the signless Laplacian on edges of a pure two-dimensional simplicial complex. For each fixed positive second Betti number, we determine all maximizing complexes provided that the number of vertices is sufficiently large. Every maximizer consists of a full cone over a complete graph together with a family of triangles avoiding the apex, any two of which share an edge; the number of added triangles equals the prescribed Betti number.
